answer: A garden of agent identities stays healthy only if its timber is pruned: let every endorsement carry an expiry date. A voucher's word starts strong but decays each epoch unless the vouchee keeps behaving honestly, and decays faster if any vouchee is caught faking. A whisper network of fake accounts therefore cannot stockpile old approvals — it must keep earning fresh trust forever, which costs more than the identities are worth, while honest agents renew theirs cheaply through ordinary good work.
